```{r}
#this age dataset ends up being different than others because I am extracting age at EEG visits rather than MRI visits
#make age datatset for Habit #copied from Habit packet #manually copied only EEG visits and deleted 1 that did not complete visit
Habit_packet <- read.csv("/Volumes/Hera/Victoria/HabitR37_packet.csv")
#/Antisaccade-impulsive-control/Habit_dems/HabitR37_packet_012725.csv

HabitEEG_age_id <- Habit_packet %>% subset(VISIT.TYPE == "EEG") %>% select(ID, DATE, D.O.B., AGE, SEX)

HabitEEG_age_id <- HabitEEG_age_id %>% rename(lunaid = "ID") %>% rename(vdate="DATE")
HabitEEG_age_id$vdate <- parse_date_time(as.character(HabitEEG_age_id$vdate), orders = c("%m/%d/%Y", "%m/%d/%y"))
HabitEEG_age_id$D.O.B. <- parse_date_time(as.character(HabitEEG_age_id$D.O.B.), orders = c("%m/%d/%Y", "%m/%d/%y"))

#recode sex M/F to 1/2
#HabitEEG_age_id <- HabitEEG_age_id %>% mutate(SEX = recode(SEX, "M" = 1, "F" = 2))

#calculate decimalized age
HabitEEG_age_id <- HabitEEG_age_id %>% mutate(Dec_Age = as.numeric(difftime(vdate, D.O.B., units = "days")) / 365.25)

#keep only first visit of repeat ids #distinct finds duplicate rows and keeps only the first row (earlier date)
HabitEEG_age_id_distinct <- HabitEEG_age_id %>% distinct(lunaid, .keep_all = TRUE)

length(unique(HabitEEG_age_id_distinct$lunaid))
summary(HabitEEG_age_id_distinct$Dec_Age)

hist1 <- hist(HabitEEG_age_id_distinct$Dec_Age, breaks = 10, col = "steelblue", border = "black")

ggplot(HabitEEG_age_id_distinct, aes(Dec_Age)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, fill="steelblue", color="black", size=0.5) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(HabitEEG_age_id_distinct, aes(x=Dec_Age)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.85, fill="steelblue")+
  facet_wrap(~ SEX, nrow = 1) +
  theme(legend.position="right")+
  theme_minimal()

#_________________________
full_ppt_sample <- merge(HabitEEG_age_id_distinct, HabitMR_age_id_distinct, by ="lunaid") #178 subjects

full_ppt_sample <- full_ppt_sample %>% 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(Dec_Age_mean = mean(c(Dec_Age.x, Dec_Age.y), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-c("Dec_Age.x", "Dec_Age.y"))
sd(full_ppt_sample$Dec_Age_mean)

full_ppt_sample <- full_ppt_sample %>% 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(sex = first(c(SEX.x, SEX.y))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-c("SEX.x", "SEX.y")) 

full_ppt_sample %>% filter(sex == "F") %>% nrow()

#----
ids_only_reho <- final_reho_fd_age %>% distinct(lunaid, .keep_all = TRUE)
merged <- merged_myelin_age %>%
  full_join(final_icvf_fd_age, by = "lunaid") %>%
  full_join(ids_only_reho, by = "lunaid") %>%  
  full_join(subset_final_as_eog_age, by = "lunaid")
n_distinct(merged$lunaid)
merged %>%
  filter(is.na(percent_corr_1_2)| is.na(RxdlPFC.x)| is.na(RxdlPFC.y) | is.na(RxdlPFC)) %>%
  summarise(n_distinct(lunaid)) #112 subjects are contributing a piece of mr or behavioral data

full_merged <- merged_myelin_age %>%
  full_join(final_icvf_fd_age, by = "lunaid") %>%
  full_join(ids_only_reho, by = "lunaid") %>%  
  full_join(HabitMR_age_id_distinct, by = "lunaid")
n_distinct(full_merged$lunaid)

full_merged %>%
  filter(!(is.na(RxdlPFC.x) & is.na(RxdlPFC.y) & is.na(RxdlPFC))) %>%
  summarize(n_distinct(lunaid)) #175 subjects are contributing at least one piece of MR data THIS IS MY FULL SAMPLE SIZE TO REPORT IN ABSTRACT
  
  Habit_MR_age_studysample <- full_merged %>%
    filter(!(is.na(RxdlPFC.x) & is.na(RxdlPFC.y) & is.na(RxdlPFC))) %>%
    distinct(lunaid)
  
study_sample <- left_join(Habit_MR_age_studysample, HabitMR_age_id_distinct, by = "lunaid")  
summary(study_sample$Dec_Age)
sd(study_sample$Dec_Age)
study_sample %>% filter(SEX == "F") %>% nrow()

#___________________________________________________________________
EEG_study_sample <- filter(HabitEEG_age_id_distinct, lunaid %in% study_sample$lunaid)
length(unique(EEG_study_sample$lunaid)) #170
```

```{r}
#EXCLUSION CRITERIA
#ppt has fewer than 25 viable trials (scored 0,1,2) and no more than 56 trials (n=56 for one session of this task)
#for just NEUTRAL TRIALS max 29 trials; ppt has fewer than 14 viable trials (scored 0,1,2) and no more than 29 trials
subset_final_as_eog_age <- subset(final_as_eog_age, total_trials>13 & total_trials<30)

#ppt has less than 50% of "on-task" trials (scored 1,2) (out of all viable trials, the amount of trials they were "on task" should be more than 50%)
subset_final_as_eog_age <- subset(subset_final_as_eog_age, percent_1_2>49)
ex_final_as_eog_age <- subset(final_as_eog_age, total_trials<13 | total_trials>30 | percent_1_2<49)
```

```{r}
#gam age predicting percent error corrected trials (out of on-task trials (1,2), not viable trials (0,1,2))
#significant
model_per_ec <- gam(percent_ec_1_2 ~ s(Dec_Age), data=subset_final_as_eog_age, method = "REML", na.action = na.exclude)
summary(model_per_ec)
#plot
mgcv::plot.gam(model_per_ec)
draw(model_per_ec)
ggplot(subset_final_as_eog_age, aes(Dec_Age, percent_ec_1_2)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method='gam', formula = (y ~ s(x, bs = "tp", k = 3))) +
  theme_classic()
####can exclude by deviation from residuals of model_per_ec
subset_final_as_eog_age$percent_ec_1_2_resid <- resid(model_per_ec)
subset_resid_per_ec <- subset(subset_final_as_eog_age, percent_ec_1_2_resid < (mean(percent_ec_1_2_resid) + 2*sd(percent_ec_1_2_resid)))
subset_resid_per_ec <- subset(subset_resid_per_ec, percent_ec_1_2_resid > (mean(percent_ec_1_2_resid) - 2*sd(percent_ec_1_2_resid)))
#run model again with new exclusion (10 less obs)
#significant
resid_model_per_ec <- gam(percent_ec_1_2 ~ s(Dec_Age), data=subset_resid_per_ec, method = "REML", na.action = na.exclude)
summary(resid_model_per_ec)
#plot
ggper_ec <- ggplot(subset_resid_per_ec, aes(Dec_Age, percent_ec_1_2)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method='gam', formula = (y ~ s(x, bs = "tp", k=3)), color= "goldenrod") +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "Percent of Error Corrected Trials") +
  theme_classic() %>%
  lunaize()
ggsave(ggper_ec, 
       filename = "ggper_ec.jpg",
       device = "jpg",
       height = 6, width = 5, units = "in")


#gam age predicting percent correct trials (out of on-task trials not viable trials)
#significant
model_per_corr <- gam(percent_corr_1_2 ~ s(Dec_Age), data=subset_final_as_eog_age, method = "REML", na.action = na.exclude)
summary(model_per_corr)
#plot
ggplot(subset_final_as_eog_age, aes(Dec_Age, percent_corr_1_2)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method='gam', formula = (y ~ s(x, bs = "tp"))) +
  theme_classic()
####can exclude by deviation from residuals of model_per_corr
subset_final_as_eog_age$percent_corr_1_2_resid <- resid(model_per_corr)
subset_resid_per_corr <- subset(subset_final_as_eog_age, percent_corr_1_2_resid < (mean(percent_corr_1_2_resid, na.rm = TRUE) + 2*sd(percent_corr_1_2_resid, na.rm = TRUE)))
subset_resid_per_corr <- subset(subset_resid_per_corr, percent_corr_1_2_resid > (mean(percent_corr_1_2_resid, na.rm = TRUE) - 2*sd(percent_corr_1_2_resid, na.rm = TRUE)))
#run model again with new exclusion (11 less obs)
#significant
resid_model_per_corr <- gam(percent_corr_1_2 ~ s(Dec_Age), data=subset_resid_per_corr, method = "REML", na.action = na.exclude)
summary(resid_model_per_corr)
 #plot
ggper_corr <- ggplot(subset_resid_per_corr, aes(Dec_Age, percent_corr_1_2)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method='gam', formula = (y ~ s(x, bs = "tp", k=3)), color= "goldenrod") +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "Percent of Correct Trials")+
  theme_classic() +
  paper_theme
ggsave(filename = "ggper_corr.pdf",
       plot = ggper_corr,
       height = 4, width = 4, units = "in", bg = 'transparent')
ggsave(ggper_corr, 
       filename = "ggper_corr.jpg",
       device = "jpg",
       height = 6, width = 5, units = "in")

#gam age predicting mean latency correct trials
#not significant
model_lat_corr<- gam(mean_lat_1 ~ s(Dec_Age), data=subset_final_as_eog_age, method = "REML", na.action = na.exclude)
summary(model_lat_corr)
#plot

####can exclude by deviation from residuals of model_lat_corr

subset_resid_lat_corr <- subset(subset_final_as_eog_age, mean_lat_1_resid < (mean(mean_lat_1_resid) + 2*sd(mean_lat_1_resid)))
subset_resid_lat_corr <- subset(subset_resid_lat_corr, mean_lat_1_resid > (mean(mean_lat_1_resid) - 2*sd(mean_lat_1_resid)))

#gam age predicting latency coefficient of variation for correct trials
#significant
model_latvar_corr<- gam(var_lat_1 ~ s(Dec_Age), data=subset_final_as_eog_age, method = "REML", na.action = na.exclude)
summary(model_latvar_corr)
#plot
ggplot(subset_final_as_eog_age, aes(Dec_Age, var_lat_1)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method='gam', formula = (y ~ s(x, bs = "tp"))) +
  theme_classic()
####can exclude by deviation from residuals of model_latvar_corr (there's 1 person with NA sd because they only have 1 correct trial)
subset_final_as_eog_age$var_lat_1_resid <- resid(model_latvar_corr)
subset_resid_latvar_corr <- subset(subset_final_as_eog_age, var_lat_1_resid < (mean(var_lat_1_resid, na.rm=TRUE) + 2*sd(var_lat_1_resid, na.rm=TRUE)))
subset_resid_latvar_corr <- subset(subset_resid_latvar_corr, var_lat_1_resid > (mean(var_lat_1_resid, na.rm=TRUE) - 2*sd(var_lat_1_resid, na.rm=TRUE)))
#run model again with new exclusion (10 less obs)

resid_model_latvar_corr <- gam(var_lat_1 ~ s(Dec_Age), data=subset_resid_latvar_corr, method = "REML", na.action = na.exclude)
summary(resid_model_latvar_corr)
#plot
gg_latvar <- ggplot(subset_resid_latvar_corr, aes(Dec_Age, var_lat_1)) +

  geom_smooth(method='gam', formula = (y ~ s(x, bs = "tp", k=3)), color= "goldenrod") +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "Latency Variability of Correct Trials") +

ggsave(filename = "gg_latvar.pdf",

ggsave(gg_latvar,
```

```{r}
#linear regressions

model_num_corr <- lm(n_1 ~ Dec_Age, subset_final_as_eog_age)
summary(model_num_corr)

ggplot(model_num_corr,aes(Dec_Age, n_1)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method='lm') +

#number of correct and ec trials by age
model_num_corr_ec <- lm(trials_1_2 ~ Dec_Age, subset_final_as_eog_age)
summary(model_num_corr_ec)

ggplot(model_num_corr_ec,aes(Dec_Age, trials_1_2)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method='lm') +
  theme_classic()

#number of total trials by age
model_num_total <- lm(total_trials ~ Dec_Age, subset_final_as_eog_age)
summary(model_num_total)

ggplot(model_num_total,aes(Dec_Age, total_trials)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method='lm') +
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
#make nice tables
install.packages("sjPlot")
library(sjPlot)
tab_model(model_per_ec, model_per_corr,
          show.p = TRUE, show.stat = TRUE,
          title = "Simple Regression Results Predicting Anti-Saccade Performance
            From Age",
          col.order = c("est", "stat", "p"), #removed "est" and "se"
          pred.labels = c("Intercept", "Age"), #can give your variable names labels
          dv.labels = c("Percent Error Corrected Trials", "Percent Correct Trials"), #column names
          string.est = "Estimate",
          string.stat = "Statistic",
          string.p = "p-value",
          file = "output1.doc")
```
